name: WARNING: Maggi Seasoning Cubes (High Sodium, MSG & Hydrolyzed Alliums)
whyItWorks: Contains extreme sodium concentrations (over 1,000mg per cube), hydrogenated palm oil, monosodium glutamate (MSG), and hydrolyzed plant proteins with hidden allium extracts. Triggers osmotic water shifts into the bowel lumen.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Replace commercial bouillon cubes with pure simmered chicken bone broth and Redmond sea salt.
